messages:
anya: nightly-eval alert: structured-output suite failure spike on PTQ variant :rotating_light:

eval-bot: nightly-run 3730012345: model=redwood-12B-ptq-packedkvv2, suite=structured-json, fail_rate +12% vs baseline

mike: which test cases are failing? short sample?
sophie: seen truncation of final JSON field on multi-turn QA prompts that include code blocks. example below:
raj: ```
input: "Give JSON with keys summary, code"
expected: {"summary":"...","code":"print('hi')"}
observed: {"summary":"...","code":"print('hi'"
```

devon: repro locally on Dedicated with image sha `sha256:abc123` — streaming chunks stop on grapheme cluster boundary after quant kernel change
anya: hypothesis: packed-kernel reordering PR (4321) changed tokenization boundary handling under int8 kernels -> streaming chunker mis-counts bytes -> early EOS
mike: I ran diff on tokenizer configs between hosted and ptq build:
```
- normalize_unicode: false
+ normalize_unicode: compat
```
sophie: also seeing higher rate when input contains emoji/zero-width-joiners
raj: logs from runtime:
```
[streamer] processed 1024 tokens, flush_when: 1, last_chunk_len: 3
[streamer] detected EOS token mid-grapheme -> closing stream
```
anya: root cause writeup draft: PTQ packed-kernel reorder introduced subtle change in subtokenization when paired with unicode normalization mode, which interacts with streaming chunker heuristics leading to truncated final tokens in structured outputs. Not a model knowledge regression.

mitigations proposed:
- immediate: rollback PTQ packed-kernel change on Dedicated pools (owner: devops-mike) — rolling back 4321 to previous kernel by 3730012400
- short-term: add gating rule to canary pipeline to run structured-json suite with strict jsonparse pass rate >= 99% for PTQ variants (owner: sophie)
- short-term: patch streaming chunker to avoid closing stream on mid-grapheme EOS and add unit tests for ZWJ/emoji (owner: raj)
- medium: add tokenizer-config parity check in model-build CI to catch normalize_unicode drift (owner: mike)
- monitoring: new per-prompt regression alert in nightly eval when any prompt family regression >5% (owner: anya)

mike: I can start rollback now, ping me if any customer-facing impact
devon: I'll open hotfix PR with tests
sophie: gating rule added to canary job draft: `structured-json-parsing >= 99%`
anya: thanks — will record RCA and actions in the incident tracker. assigning owners and followups.
raj: :thumbsup:
mike: rollback started :hourglass_flowing_sand:
devon: PR opened: #4433
eval-bot: nightly-run followup scheduled in 30m: will re-run structured-json suite on rolled-back image
anya: closing thread, we'll post final notes when followup run completes :white_check_mark:
